newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Kidnappers demand $5 mln for Taiwan actress' daughter.
newsitem.headline: Kidnappers demand $5 mln for Taiwan actress' daughter.

text.p: Kidnappers have abducted the 16-year-old daughter of a Taiwan actress, cut off part of the girl's finger and demanded a US$5 million ransom, one of the highest ever on the island, police said on Saturday.

Pai Hsiao-yen, the only daughter of talk show hostess Pai Ping-ping, was kidnapped on April 14 on her way to school, police said. The kidnappers chopped off half her left little finger, sent it to her mother and demanded a US$5 million ransom.
Police said they arrested four suspects on Friday night, but were still searching for two main suspects who still held the victim, who they believe is still alive.
A weeping Pai Ping-ping urged the suspects to return her daughter.
"No child should suffer like this...please release my child," she told a press conference on Saturday.
Pai Ping-ping, a popular Taiwan actress, hosts several television talk and variety shows.
President Lee Teng-hui expressed his concern over the kidnapping through his presidential spokesman and urged police to solve the case as soon as possible.
Taiwan reported 156 kidnapping cases in 1996, the highest number since 187 cases in 1990, the state-run Central News Agency reported on Saturday.
In January and February, 34 kidnapping cases were reported, all of which had been solved, the agency said.
